scope: Full named ORD HTE source, frozen retained ELN GNN/forest; no training, tuning, model selection or adaptation.
eligibility: Every source row; original quantitative input parser and unambiguous desired-product percentage yield [0,100]; reject exact structural/temperature ELN clones. Count every rejection, no sampling cap.
test_exposure: Full cohort includes previously observed lowest-SHA256 2048 source identifiers. Remaining records are newly evaluated, but no fully blind independent test claim. Old subset scores remain historical.
outputs: Fresh aggregate docs/full-hte/results.json; per-reaction predictions only ignored data/interim/full-hte/predictions.jsonl. No raw reactions or weights committed.
failure_policy: Fail on changed hashes, unexpected source count, duplicate identifiers, nonfinite predictions or existing outputs. Preserve failures and do not change policies in response to scores.
